name: Platform Hosting Card Setup (3DS)
description: Client registers a card once for automatic hosting billing. From the project payments page the client opens the card modal, enters card data, and the card is tokenized into a Wompi payment source. When the card requires 3D Secure, an authentication flow runs (browser-info/fingerprint hidden iframes, then a visible bank challenge iframe) polled every 2s until the source is AVAILABLE. On success the card is stored on the subscription and the first open payment is charged. The same flow handles 'Cambiar tarjeta'. A failed payment can be retried manually with the stored card. E2E mocks Wompi + 3DS (the challenge iframe is :srcdoc, no live sandbox): the AVAILABLE happy path and the PENDING → 3DS challenge path.
